content.name: Assassin's Blood
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

content.name: Assassin's Blood
entries: A creature subjected to Assassin's Blood makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.
